text: Case-study slides render on the GOLD frame (92px rail, 3x3 dot mark, IBM Plex Mono kicker CASE STUDY · SUBJECT, action title in Archivo SemiBold for NXT or Lora Medium for NU, mono meta row, hairline, takeaway band) with three deep-dive variants driven by CaseStudyData.variant: four-block (default), before-after (beforeAfter payload, warn/cool wash panels + RESULT + cited quote), evidence-stack (evidence[] verbatim quotes + WHAT IT SHOWS). Diversify variants across a deck. Twins that MUST stay in sync: components/slideTemplates/web.tsx GoldFrame+CaseStudySlide (960x540 preview), services/slideToStageHtml.ts renderCaseStudy (1920x1080 export), wiki/design-system/gold/case-study-{nxt,nu}.html (fill targets), and hic-workspace/design-system/figma-tokens.json refreshed via Figma MCP from nodes 223:2 (NXT) / 97:2 (NU). See design-system/gold-visual-language and brand/figma-node-map. (source: user, confidence 1.0)

Density variants exist on EVERY slide template, not just case-study. The slide-level field density: base|dense (fence attr density=dense, JSON "density", or the #dense hashtag) raises per-template item ceilings via the shared DENSITY_SPEC in components/slideTemplates/types.ts (densityCaps). The Analyst Desk model MUST interpret additions and modifications to hashtag deliverable generations that warrant a denser artifact (more detail / more lines / more quotes / add items beyond the base ceiling) by emitting density=dense rather than dropping items. Both twins honor the axis: web.tsx preview (clamped to the 540px canvas) and slideToStageHtml.ts (the 1920x1080 PPTX stage twin, full-fidelity dense surface) with count-adaptive type so dense never overflows the 16:9 canvas. Density raises ceilings, not floors: never pad to a ceiling; every added item must be evidenced. (source: user, confidence 1.0)

Every artifact hashtag in Analyst chat (#slides #journey #personas #themes #recs #prd #gap #blueprint #competitive #case-study #roadmap #audit #arch) force-routes generation to claude-fable-5 inside corpusChatService.sendChatMessage, BEFORE buildGroundingContext so Fable conservative maxCorpusChars (600K, window UNVERIFIED) governs corpus packing. Plain non-hashtag chat defaults to gemini-3.5-flash and respects the picker. Designer chat (chatToSlideSpec, chatToFreeform, 3 DesignDeskChat call sites) also routes to claude-fable-5. claude-fable-5 REJECTS the temperature param with a 400 (same as opus-4-8); the proxy /api/ai/anthropic strips it (regex opus-4-[789]|fable) and clients omit it. Pricing in costMeter is a PLACEHOLDER (Opus 4.8 rates) until official rates publish. (confidence 1.0)

Case-study deck = (a) COVER: named portfolio (3-4 real subjects) as challenge->approach->outcome cards PLUS a cross-case comparison axis (the synthesis dimension) and a dark takeaway band; (b) one DEEP-DIVE per named subject in the cases.pptx-inspired rich layout: kicker CASE STUDY dot SUBJECT, action-title headline, profile/timeframe/investment meta row, CHALLENGE/APPROACH/OUTCOME/LESSON accent-bar blocks (left), KEY OUTCOME stat panel (qualitative hero phrase + 3 supporting stats + verbatim quote with named SOURCE) right, applicability-to-client on a teal left-border, Sources footer. Diversify deep-dive layouts (4-block+panel, before/after split, evidence stack); never repeat one layout. Numbers qualitative unless inside a cited quote. (source: user, confidence 1.0)

The self-improvement loop is OPERATIONAL end to end: session rollouts (hic-workspace/sessions) -> npm run skillopt:extract -> skillopt:build-training -> bash scripts/skillopt-batch.sh --auto-promote (gated by the validation gate: structural integrity + hygiene-score non-regression + failure-pattern coverage). First live pass 2026-06-10 promoted 8 skill candidates including recommendation-architect. Analyst-chat feedback (chatFeedbackExtractor, #refine edits) and Design Desk edits accumulate in sessions/ and learned-constraints; re-run the batch after meaningful feedback accumulates. NEVER bypass the validation gate. (source: auto+user, confidence 0.95)

The 7-step artifact routine is MANDATORY and ORDERED, never skip or reorder: 1 Education (READ the expert SKILL.md for that artifact), 2 Inspiration (gold twin + nu-design-gallery + curation), 3 Guardrails (run anti-slop hooks on copy; build only on exit 0), 4 Generation (Figma clone-shell, neutral scenario, quote per record), 5 Review (screenshot + collision/clip audit), 6 Dual-brand (build in BOTH NXT and NU files), 7 Wiki/manifest + self-improvement (register frames in figma-node-map, re-chunk, record constraints). Reading a gold twin or an inspiration file is NOT a substitute for Step 1 reading the expert skill. (source: user, confidence 1.0)

When a recommendation payload carries actionTitle + rationale + actions + evidence + impactGrid + impactMetric + implication ALL at once, the stage twin (slideToStageHtml renderRecommendation) uses the denseSa count-adaptive type scale + tightened spacing + reduced char budgets so the 1080px stage never overflows. Verified by PPTX geometry audit (python-pptx shape bounds vs canvas): the KEY OUTCOME panel previously landed at 7.675in on a 7.5in canvas. Audit every exported deck for out-of-canvas shapes; preview line-clamps HIDE stage overflow so preview-clean does not prove export-clean. (source: live export audit, confidence 1.0)

Chat retrieval is three-tier manifest-only: tier-1 engagement-tagged catalog, tier-2 committed KL selection, tier-3 WHOLE-WIKI manifest catalog (engagement empty query, pre-rank + MMR narrow). When tiers 1+2 are empty the system falls to tier-3, NEVER to bulk-RAG. The 2026-04-20 wiki pre-fetch (20 embedding-ranked article bodies) is SUPPRESSED for every artifact-hashtag generation; it remains only for plain-chat Q&A. RAG injection is the documented root cause of hollow deliverables. (source: user, confidence 1.0)

The design system now has REAL Figma variable collections: NXT VariableCollectionId:221:2 (file iSQhAVM7SI4QHAWB7y9C2z) and NU VariableCollectionId:95:2 (file z2v9Pvhg23hlljEitPBdAt), with semantic color/font/space/radius tokens. Ground brand fidelity against design-system/design-context-cache.md (extracted token values), and BIND new Figma frame fills to these variables (setBoundVariableForPaint) rather than pasting literal hex, so get_variable_defs stays meaningful. (source: user, confidence 0.9)

Multi-slide deliverables (personas, prd, themes, recommendations, case-studies, journeys, blueprints, presentation, slides) render as a GENERAL overview slide plus one or more DETAIL deep-dive slides, one deep-dive per key record; the deep-dives must use DIVERSIFIED layouts (split two-column, hero-quote, baseline-target-guardrail table, behavioral fingerprint, timeline, evidence stack, before-after) and never just repeat the overview layout. (source: user, confidence 0.9)

Case-study subjects MUST be NAMED real entities (institution/company/program). Composite or archetype subjects (Self-Serve Leader, Omnichannel Incumbent, a leading company, a top-25 program) are a forbidden anti-pattern and read as generic slop. For the design-system exemplar use real publicly-known CX-leader companies as REPRESENTATIVE illustrative subjects (firewall: illustrative content, not client data), never invented archetypes. (source: user, confidence 1.0)

A PRD is a MULTI-SLIDE deck covering all 16 Cagan/SVPG sections, never a single user-stories page: cover/problem statement, user stories (6 or more), one or more story-detail slides (Given/When/Then acceptance criteria plus a success-metric table with baseline/target/guardrail plus why-must-have), functional and non-functional requirements with dependencies and out-of-scope, and milestones/risks/sign-off. (source: user, confidence 0.9)

Every design-system build must hit all three layers in one pass: the Figma file (both brands), the wiki and manifest (register each slide frame in figma-node-map and re-chunk via the proxy), and the self-improvement engine (record the rule into learned-constraints via record_feedback); a build that updates Figma only is incomplete. (source: user, confidence 0.9)

When generating gap_analysis gap-impact section, make each gap's impact concrete by naming the affected system, team, or stakeholder and the operational consequence; any figure must appear only inside a cited verbatim quote with its source, never as a standalone assertion (per the Quantitative Claim Rule). (source: 5 feedback signals, confidence 0.85)

When generating the gap-impact section, make each gap's impact concrete by naming the affected system, team, or stakeholder and the operational consequence; any figure must appear only inside a cited verbatim quote with its source, never as a standalone assertion (Quantitative Claim Rule). (source: 5 feedback signals, confidence 0.85)

Never drift from the build routine. If asked to GET INSPIRED or rebuild, that does NOT authorize skipping Step 1 Education: re-read the expert skill FIRST, then inspiration, then build. When the user signals drift, repeat the 7-step sequence back and resume at the earliest skipped step. (source: user, confidence 1.0)

When generating personas persona-quote section, use verbatim excerpts directly from user research interviews because generic quotes undermine authenticity and fail to capture the distinctive voice and genuine perspective of actual users. (source: 5 feedback signals, confidence 0.85)

Kicker eyebrows stay TYPE then DOMAIN only (e.g. BEHAVIORAL PERSONA then CUSTOMER SUPPORT); never stuff a trait tagline or a PEAKS-AT / PEAKS-WEEKS positional microlabel into the eyebrow, the GOLD spec bans PEAKS-style eyebrow microlabels. (source: user, confidence 0.9)

Pain points belong WITHIN each phase (a pain row carrying multiple pains per phase), never as a separate across-phase synthesis band; the journey carries actions, within-phase pains, and a verbatim quote in every actor cell. (source: user, 2026-06-09, confidence 0.85)

Never render an N-of-M positional counter for any artifact (e.g. "PERSONA 02 OF 04", "GAP 01 OF 04", "EXHIBIT 3 OF 7"); it is reporting-depth pagination chrome. Use the artifact category plus its trait, never the count. (source: user, 2026-06-09, confidence 0.9)

Deck-type deliverables (prd, strategy-deck, journey-with-slides, report) render as MULTIPLE 1920x1080 slide frames on the page, not one crowded page; each slide is a distinct frame covering one section of the deliverable structure. (source: user, confidence 0.9)

When generating roadmap horizon-now section, give every horizon item a specific success metric with a named baseline and a timeframe (the measurement four-tuple), so each item is verifiable rather than aspirational. (source: 4 feedback signals, confidence 0.80)

Give every horizon item a specific success metric with a named baseline and a timeframe (the measurement four-tuple); state the metric qualitatively with its timeframe so no naked number appears as an assertion. (source: 4 feedback signals, confidence 0.80)

The h1 action-title must clear the top-right brand wordmark: cap its width near 1400px from the left rail rather than filling the full content width, so a long title wraps to a second line instead of running under the logo. (source: user, confidence 0.9)

When generating personas persona-quote section, use verbatim excerpts from actual user research because generic or fabricated quotes lack authenticity and fail to capture the genuine voice of the user. (source: 5 feedback signals, confidence 0.85)

Every top-level record (gap, theme, recommendation, persona, blueprint stage, journey cell) carries at least one verbatim quote with a named SOURCE; a quote in every cell, not the 40 percent floor. (source: user, 2026-06-09, confidence 0.9)

When generating the persona-quote section, use verbatim excerpts from actual user research; generic or fabricated quotes lack the authenticity needed to represent real user experience. (source: 5 feedback signals, confidence 0.85)

Every design-system artifact is produced in BOTH the NXT and the NU brand file with identical geometry and swapped brand tokens; an artifact built in one brand only is incomplete. (source: user, 2026-06-09, confidence 0.9)

Each theme carries prevalence (DOMINANT or RECURRING), sentiment, sub-themes, and a tension line in addition to name, thesis, and quote; never a bare name plus quote. (source: user, 2026-06-09, confidence 0.85)

Never expose research-process or methodology chrome (corpus, six-lens scan, "what the evidence says", confidence chips, candidate counts); lead with the insight. (source: user, 2026-06-09, confidence 0.9)
When generating roadmap horizon-now section, ensure every horizon item has a specific quantified success metric with baseline and timeframe. (source: 4 feedback signals from learning-pass simulation)
Enlarge and extend text fields on slides to use more of the whitespace; vertically balance content so there is no dead band above the takeaway. (source: 3 feedback signals, confidence 0.75)
Recommendations render as a DEFENSIBLE CONSENSUS row plus a visually distinct NON-OBVIOUS BETS row (cool top-border); never a single flat row. (source: user, 2026-06-09, confidence 0.85)
Use verbatim excerpts from actual user research; generic or fabricated quotes lack authenticity. (source: user, confidence 0.85)
Label the evidence lane Touchpoints, never Evidence, unless it carries a verbatim corpus quote. (source: user, confidence 0.85)
Enlarge and extend text fields on slides to use more of the whitespace.
Include at least three pain points per phase in the journey map.
Align sources directly underneath quotes in slides.

The journey-map matrix IS the entire slide body. Personas render as a PERSONAS JTBD-voice row inside the table, pain points render as STACKED per-phase cells (at least three evidenced pains per phase; painPoints[i] accepts string[]), strategic opportunities render as an OPPORTUNITIES row (cool accent), kpiTiles EMBED inside their phase header cells. All four arrays are ORDERED BY JOURNEY ARC and distribute start->end across phase columns by array position. Nothing sits on top of the table. Twins: web.tsx JourneyMapSlide + slideToStageHtml renderJourneyMap + types.ts JourneyMapData + the SLIDE OUTPUT PROTOCOL journey-map block; anatomy page design-system/journey-map-in-table-anatomy.md (manifest-chunked). Figma GOLD journey frames (NU 53:159/156:2, NXT 75:2) rebuild to this anatomy PENDING. (source: user feedback 2026-06-12 + fb_1781292121810, confidence 1.0)

The Figma GOLD journey in-table frames are BUILT (NU 232:2 on GOLD · journey (nu), NXT 333:2 on GOLD · journey (nxt)) as nested auto-layout matrices matching design-system/journey-map-in-table-anatomy.md; this CLEARS the rebuild-PENDING note in [journey/matrix-is-the-body]. Remaining deviation: fills are raw hex pending a variable-binding pass against collections NXT 221:2 / NU 95:2. (source: build 2026-06-12, confidence 1.0)

chatFeedbackExtractor NEVER silently drops a signal: JSON salvage (first {...} substring) -> deterministic regex fallback classification (imperative/always-never phrasing -> correction/rule at 0.55 confidence, below auto-promotion) -> 2 attempts. learned-constraints appends DEDUP by CONSTRAINT [key] at the proxy /api/wiki/append chokepoint (duplicate-only appends return deduped=true without writing). (confidence 1.0)

_runBreadthShard primary = claude-fable-5 (schema described in-prompt, no temperature, 32K out, 2 attempts) with the Gemini 3.1 Pro -> GPT-5.5 chain as untouched fallback; eliminates the Gemini repetition-collapse class at the source. No seed support on Anthropic - determinism rides the fixed catalog windows. (confidence 1.0)

/api/wiki/write accepts engagement; injects/extends the frontmatter engagement slug list (newline-safe; mirrors write-article); writeWikiPage(opts {chunk, engagement}); upload seeding passes both. VERIFIED live: tagged page returns its chunk pointer on the engagement-scoped tier-1 query. Every NEW ingest path MUST pass chunk:true + engagement. (confidence 1.0)

buildManifestCorpusForGoal (chunkRetrieval.ts) is THE single grounding entry for non-slide deliverable engines. #recommendations + the HTML directives now lead with it (embedding article-RAG demoted to fallback, raw corpus last). New deliverable engines consume the helper, never per-engine retrieval. (confidence 1.0)

Truncation in deliverables makes them unusable. Character budgets are GENERATION-side summarization targets: the SLIDE OUTPUT PROTOCOL carries per-field budgets (cells <=100, stacked items <=80, persona voice <=95, takeaway <=200) and demands COMPLETE thoughts - the model compresses the idea, never the renderer. Source attributions never ride inside tight list items (slide-level sources[] + evidence fields carry them). Render-side trunc() (stage twin) and truncate() (web twin) are clause-aware last resorts that finish the sentence (<=1.35x budget), else end at a sentence/clause boundary, and NEVER emit an ellipsis. Writing voice: plain human consultant sentences (subject-verb-object, concrete nouns, one idea per cell, varied openings). (source: user feedback 2026-06-12 screenshot, confidence 1.0)

Slide deliverables obey the Figma-sourced typographic system (gold-visual-language.md Typographic-system + nxt-visual-renderer/references/typographic-system.md). The action title is the ONE governing line and the largest text on every content slide; hero numerals/words are EVIDENCE capped at the hero-cap (subhead, below the title) in body weight, never out-ranking the title; labels recede via the label tier + grey, never heavier than the content they introduce; nothing renders below the 8.5pt floor (overflow to a continuation slide instead, never truncate mid-sentence); UPPERCASE is for the kicker only; one brand-accent emphasis per slide. Sizes come from the scale (label/caption/body/lead/name/subhead/title/display), hydrated from /api/design-tokens - never invent sizes. Enforced by validate_text_hierarchy.py + the renderer twins (slideToStageHtml.ts + web.tsx read SCALE/WEIGHT/TYPO). Verified 2026-06-14: all 27 real .pptx exports pass title-dominance + 8pt floor. (source: user goal 2026-06-14, confidence 1.0)

A #proto build shipped with a render defect (BLANK mount) after 1 repair attempts (slug=advancement-alignment-cockpit). The orchestrator/pod prompts must guarantee: root component named exactly App; state.activeScreen matches a built Screen_<id>; every screen binds only to defined state keys; no import/export/render() in emitted code. (source: headless render gate 2026-06-17)
Always include a methodology appendix at the end of executive search decks.
